notes: The constitution is human-authored and immutable at runtime. bounds are hard limits for every genome mutation; immutable entries (base model, task, evaluation protocol, gating rule, self-generation mode) can never be changed by the daemon. selfgen_mode 'answer' = verified self-training: the model samples k answer attempts, correctness-filtered against ground truth, and trains on its own verified completions plus hard-mined gold examples for every miss; 'rationale' (STaR free-text bootstrapping) is intended for instruction-following base models. Any change to this file requires a human commit.
